name: EDEN by Basecamp Research
description:
EDEN is Basecamp Research's frontier biological foundation model, trained on BaseData — the
world's largest biological dataset, encompassing over 10 billion novel genes from more than a million species collected across 200+ sampling expeditions in 30+ countries.

This connector gives Claude access to two EDEN capabilities:

Antibiotic design (EDEN-AMP): Generate novel antimicrobial peptide candidates with predicted
potency against 11 drug-resistant bacterial strains, including MRSA, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. 97% of EDEN-designed AMPs are active in the lab; one candidate showed efficacy in mice comparable to last-resort antibiotics.

Vaccine target prioritisation (EDEN-Immunogenicity): Predict the probability that a protein-coding antigen will trigger an immune response, using EDEN embeddings with AUROC 0.85 on external validation data. Reduces weeks of empirical target selection to a single workflow. Every BaseData sequence is collected under informed-consent and benefit-sharing agreements, with each sequence traceable to country-specific collection permits. For research use only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add EDEN by Basecamp Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add EDEN by Basecamp Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-public.basecamp-research.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the EDEN by Basecamp Research MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: EDEN by Basecamp Research provides these MCP tools: create_dataset_upload, delete_dataset, generate_antimicrobial_peptides, list_datasets, predict_immunogenicity, and create_dataset_download.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to EDEN by Basecamp Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to EDEN by Basecamp Research in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Groupon, SNOMED CT Terminology, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Aiva, and Amass Connector.

_published_faq.name: Does EDEN by Basecamp Research MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: EDEN by Basecamp Research requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops EDEN by Basecamp Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: EDEN by Basecamp Research is developed by Basecamp Research. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
